text:
Messaging reliability and readability

• Chats that got stuck on "couldn't decrypt" now repair themselves — you no longer have to send a message first
• Fixed messages being permanently lost when the app was closed while receiving
• Fixed "couldn't decrypt" after editing a message
• The chat header now shows the full "last seen" time instead of cutting it off
• Security notices are no longer truncated mid-sentence
• Cropped photos no longer keep the original photo's empty border
